name: CA-08
label: Safe D

key_factors: District's strong Democratic lean of D+19
Incumbent John Garamendi running for re-election with a large cash advantage
Republican challenger raised under $9,000 with minimal resources
Prediction markets price Democratic win at about 96%
model.rationale: Garamendi holds a seat that leans Democratic by 19 points, has over $1.1 million on hand, and faces a challenger who has raised less than $9,000. Markets price this at roughly 96% Democratic, consistent with the fundamentals pointing to a blowout.
model.watch: A sudden influx of outside spending for the Republican challenger or an unexpected scandal involving Garamendi would be the main things to watch, though neither appears likely.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
California's 8th district leans Democratic by 19 points, and incumbent John Garamendi is seeking re-election with the advantages that status brings. He has raised about $489,000 and holds more than $1.1 million in cash, while Republican Rudy Recile has raised under $9,000 and reports roughly $1,500 on hand. No outside groups are spending in the race on either side.

No public polls or expert ratings cover the contest, so the outlook rests on district fundamentals, the financial gap, and prediction markets, which price a Democratic win at about 96%. Everything points to a comfortable Garamendi victory, with the only uncertainty being how large the margin turns out to be.
